nodes.title: Make the app deployable with Deploy-Manager
nodes.summary: Add the files Deploy-Manager needs to build and publish paper-cutout, which is a static Vite and React single-page app. Cover its deployment config or manifest, a pinned Node 18+ version, the install and build steps (`npm install`, then `npm run build`), and `dist/` as the output directory. Make sure the Vite base path and asset paths work at the target URL. Keep `node_modules` and `dist` out of version control. Add a short Deployment section to the README describing the setup and how to run or preview a production build locally.

nodes.title: Verify the production build before release
nodes.summary: Confirm the app is ready to ship once the deployment files are in place. Re-run the automated checks (`npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm test`, `npm run build`) on the final commit. Serve the build with `npm run preview` and complete the browser acceptance checklist in `docs/verification.md`, including the environment details, calibration and true-size checks, and results log, which are currently blank. Also tidy the production page title (currently the generic 'Shape viewer') so the deployed site is identifiable as paper-cutout.
